description: Unreadable directory holding a secret; the scan must survive without reading it. POSIX-only: Windows cannot chmod a directory away from readable, so the fixture degenerates there (the unit suite skips it too). Gates other than 6 and the secrets count were verified via the POSIX run of the same tree; G5 is not_applicable (no skills anywhere) and G7 is not_applicable (no git). G6=pass and secrets=0 follow from the unreadable-content contract asserted by test_f10_permissions: no key in the files that could be read, and without git there is no prevention to miss.
